name: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt
desc: A frozen yogurt interpretation of the classic strawberry flavor.

sections.title: Strawberry Concentrate
ingredients: 1 lbs fresh strawberries, hulled and halved
steps: In a saucepan, combine the strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice. Cook over medium heat until the volume reduces to 30%.
Remove from heat and blend. Chill in the fridge.

sections.title: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt Base
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk until the sugar is dissolved.
Chill in the fridge for at least 4 hours before churning.

sections.title: Assembly
steps: Churn in an ice cream maker until it reaches a soft-serve consistency.
